body.x: FALCON will showcase a portable camping entertainmentsatellite broadcast reception system at CES 2019, the world's largesttechnology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) 2019 to Jan. 11(Fri)

FALCON was established in 1987 as a satellite broadcastingreceiver product manufacturing leisure ICT venture company. The main businessitems that are attracting attention in the market are leisure entertainment TVand satellite automatic tracking antenna product which can be easily installedby consumers. Based on its long experience in the field of specialization,FALCON is always launching its products to the market with leading-edgecreative technology development products.

Using GNSS satellite navigation system, it can auto-track170 broadcast satellites around the world. It can automatically track andreceive satellite broadcasts by non-specialist consumers. It also has automaticsatellite tracking function that automatically recognizes azimuth, elevationangle and skew functions that can be used for motor homes, caravans, and whenmoving. In addition, the portable satellite broadcasting reception system wasdesigned and manufactured as a function that can be directly installed by aconsumer who is a non-specialist.
